goal: Write iniparse.py with parse(text) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]] for INI text. Section headers look like [name] with surrounding whitespace ignored. Lines whose first non-space character is ; or # are comments; blank lines are ignored. Entries are key=value or key: value, split on the first = or : (whichever comes first); keys and values are stripped, and keys are lowercased while section names keep their case. Entries before any section go in the section 'DEFAULT'. A repeated key in one section keeps the last value. A repeated section header merges into the existing section. Any other non-empty line raises ValueError whose message includes the 1-based line number. Include a pytest suite.
